BUILDING CONSTRUCTION — MOCK EXAM #18
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: BUILDING CONSTRUCTION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Internal Cooking Timer
   B. Input Cable Tester
   C. Information and Communication Technology
   D. International Cricket Team

2. When learning Fixings and Fittings, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Fixings and Fittings.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Fixings and Fittings.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Fixings and Fittings.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Fixings and Fittings.

3. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Run with the tool
   B. Remove all guards
   C. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   D. Work alone with eyes closed

4. When learning Introduction to Building Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Building Drawing.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Building Drawing.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Building Drawing.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Building Drawing.

5. When learning Building Construction Project Phase 11, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

6. When learning Floor Finishes, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   B. Skip safety briefings for Floor Finishes.

7. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   B. Overload every socket
   C. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   D. Ignore burnt cables

8. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Keyboard
   B. Speaker
   C. Monitor
   D. CPU

9. When learning Pre-cast Concrete Products, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Pre-cast Concrete Products.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Pre-cast Concrete Products.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Pre-cast Concrete Products.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Pre-cast Concrete Products.

10. When learning Wall Finishes, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Wall Finishes.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Wall Finishes.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Wall Finishes.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Wall Finishes.

11. When learning Careers and Entrepreneurship in Building Construction, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

13. When learning Building Material Schedules, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Building Material Schedules.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Building Material Schedules.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Building Material Schedules.

14. When learning Computer Aided Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer Aided Drawing.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer Aided Drawing.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer Aided Drawing.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Computer Aided Drawing.

15. When learning Waste Water Disposal, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Waste Water Disposal.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Pre-cast Concrete Products and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Building Material Schedules and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
